issue_title: window.can_steal_focus = False is ignored for floating windows
issue_body:
### Issue description

I recently noticed that `window.can_steal_focus = False` is sometimes ignored.

I'm not yet sure under what conditions exactly.

For example this window here gained focus even though it had `window.can_steal_focus = False` set via `@hook.subscribe.client_new`:
```
_QUBES_VMWINDOWID(WINDOW): window id # 0xa00001
_QUBES_VMNAME(STRING) = "vm"
_QUBES_LABEL_COLOR(CARDINAL) = 0
_QUBES_LABEL(CARDINAL) = 8
WM_CLASS(STRING) = "vm:zenity", "vm:Zenity"
_NET_WM_ICON(CARDINAL) =        Icon (128 x 128):
        (not shown)

WM_PROTOCOLS(ATOM): protocols  WM_DELETE_WINDOW
WM_NORMAL_HINTS(WM_SIZE_HINTS):
WM_COMMAND(STRING) = {  }
WM_ICON_NAME(UTF8_STRING) = "zenity"
WM_NAME(UTF8_STRING) = "zenity"
_QUBES_VMWINDOWID(WINDOW): window id # 0xa00003
_QUBES_VMNAME(STRING) = "vm"
_QUBES_LABEL_COLOR(CARDINAL) = 0
_QUBES_LABEL(CARDINAL) = 8
WM_CLASS(STRING) = "vm", "vm"
_NET_WM_ICON(CARDINAL) =        Icon (128 x 128):
        (not shown)

WM_PROTOCOLS(ATOM): protocols  WM_DELETE_WINDOW
WM_NORMAL_HINTS(WM_SIZE_HINTS):
                program specified size: 1 by 1
WM_COMMAND(STRING) = {  }
WM_ICON_NAME(STRING) = "Pixmap"
WM_NAME(STRING) = "VMapp command"
_NET_FRAME_EXTENTS(CARDINAL) = 7, 7, 7, 7
_NET_WM_STATE(ATOM) = _NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE, _NET_WM_STATE_FOCUSED
_NET_WM_DESKTOP(CARDINAL) = 0
WM_STATE(WM_STATE):
                window state: Normal
                icon window: 0x0
WM_TRANSIENT_FOR(WINDOW): window id # 0x4000100
_QUBES_VMWINDOWID(WINDOW): window id # 0xa00008
_QUBES_VMNAME(STRING) = "vm"
_QUBES_LABEL_COLOR(CARDINAL) = 0
_QUBES_LABEL(CARDINAL) = 8
WM_CLASS(STRING) = "vm:zenity", "vm:Zenity"
_NET_WM_ICON(CARDINAL) =        Icon (128 x 128):
        (not shown)

WM_PROTOCOLS(ATOM): protocols  WM_DELETE_WINDOW
WM_NORMAL_HINTS(WM_SIZE_HINTS):
                program specified location: 0, 0
                program specified minimum size: 239 by 142
                program specified maximum size: 239 by 142
                program specified base size: 0 by 0
WM_COMMAND(STRING) = {  }
WM_ICON_NAME(UTF8_STRING) = "Coffee time"
WM_NAME(UTF8_STRING) = "Coffee time"
```

Possibly it's related to some special treatment for `WM_TRANSIENT_FOR` windows?

### Version

0.30.0

### Backend

X11 (default)

### Config

```python
https://github.com/3hhh/qubes-qtile
```

### Logs

```text

```

### Required

- [x] I have searched past issues to see if this bug has already been reported, and it hasn't been.
- [x] I understand that people give their precious time for free, and thus I've done my very best to make this problem as easy as possible to investigate.
